items.markdown:
The best time to visit Khao Sok National Park is during the dry season from **December to April** . These months offer the most comfortable weather for jungle trekking, kayaking, and exploring Cheow Lan Lake, as well as a chance to spot the rare, giant Rafflesia flower.[](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/when-to-visit-khaosok) [[1]](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/when-to-visit-khaosok)[[2]](https://www.roughguides.com/thailand/southern-thailand-andaman-coast/khao-sok-national-park/)

A more localized and detailed breakdown of the seasons can help tailor your itinerary:

**Dry Season (December – April)** 

- **Why go:** This is peak season for a reason. The weather is dry and sunny, making it ideal for navigating forest trails, bamboo rafting, and swimming in the emerald waters of the lake.
- **What to consider:** Because of the perfect weather, tours and floating bungalows book up well in advance . Prices are at their highest.[](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/when-to-visit-khaosok) [[1]](https://www.muchbetteradventures.com/magazine/khao-sok-national-park-guide/)[[2]](https://www.tiktok.com/@explorewithjain/video/7443449248986696992)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sJRHU9yvSR4&t=523)

**Green / Rainy Season (May – November)** 

- **Why go:** If you want a lush, misty rainforest experience with roaring waterfalls and fewer crowds, this is the time to visit. You’ll also find better deals on accommodations and tours. The water levels during this season make it fantastic for river tubing and kayaking.[](https://www.khaosoktravel.com/when-to-visit-khaosok) [[1]](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/thailand-rainy-season-is-it-a-good-time-to-visit-khao-sok/)
- **What to consider:** Khao Sok is one of the wettest places in Thailand. While heavy rains often pass within an hour, they can make trails muddy, and some caves might temporarily close for safety. This is also prime leech season, so packing appropriate gear (like long socks or trousers) is crucial.[](https://www.facebook.com/groups/627200975879253/posts/1410807987518544/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/627200975879253/posts/1410807987518544/)[[2]](https://www.elephanthills.com/when-to-visit/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sJRHU9yvSR4&t=523)

**Planning your trip:** 

- **Duration:** Plan to spend at least 1.5 to 2 days here to experience both the jungle village and a night in a floating lake bungalow.[[1]](https://www.indietraveller.co/khao-sok-national-park-travel-guide/)
- **Booking:** If you are visiting during the high season, you can lock in your floating bungalow and guided safaris using platforms like [Khao Sok.com](https://www.khaosok.com/when-to-visit/) . For packages and multi-day tours, check options on [Khao Sok Travel](https://www.khaosok.com/).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BaPMmJPmS40)
- **Travel Time:** The park is accessible via major transport hubs. If you are flying in, you'll likely land in Surat Thani (a 2-hour bus ride away) or Phuket/Krabi (a 3-hour drive).[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/627200975879253/posts/1313829930549684/)
